00256 /* HxBtFindDevices */
00257 /**
00258  * This function performs a Bluetooth inquiry.  All Bluetooth devices in range
00259  * will be found up to max_found.
00260  *
00261  * @param handle      IN  Handle to the Bluetooth library
00262  * @param to_msecs    IN  Timeout in milliseconds of the inquiry
00263  * @param max_found   IN  Maximum number of devices to find
00264  * @param foundDevcb  IN  Callback function that is called every time a device
00265  *                        is found
00266  * @param findCmpltcb IN  Callback function that is called when the inquiry is
00267  *                        finished
00268  * @param flags       IN  Flags to choose if you need new devices or trusted devices
00269  * @param data        IN  User data that the callback functions will be able to receive
00270  * @return            BtErrSuccess on success, error value if error occured
00271  *
00272  *****************************************************************************/
00273 BtErr_t  HxBtFindDevices(BtHandle handle,
00274                          UInt32 to_msecs,
00275                          UInt16 max_found,
00276                          BtFindDevFn_t foundDevcb,
00277                          BtFindCompleteFn_t findCmpltcb,
00278                          UInt8 flags,
00279                          UserData_t data);
00280 
00281 /*****************************************************************************/
00282 /* HxBtEnumerateTrustedDevices */
00283 /**
00284  * This function enumerates all the BT trusted devices 
00285  *
00286  * @param handle      IN  Handle to the Bluetooth library
00287  * @param max_found   IN  Maximum number of devices to find
00288  * @param pairedDevFn IN  Callback function that is called after enumerating all 
00289  *                        devices is complete
00290  * @param data        IN  User data that the callback functions will be able to receive
00291  * @return            BtErrSuccess on success, error value if error occured
00292  *
00293  *****************************************************************************/
00294 
00295 extern inline BtErr_t HxBtEnumerateTrustedDevices(BtHandle handle, BtPairedDeviceResultFn_t pairedDevFn, UserData_t data)
00296 {
00297     /*UserData_t data = NULL;*/
00298     return HxBtFindDevices(handle, 0, 0, pairedDevFn, 0, INQ_PAIRED_DEVICES, data);
00299 }
